The five building and roof modules in `source/packages` and
`painted-materials-bbe33709.png` are unchanged copies of the previously reviewed
Nautilus original building/roof sources at
`2502646482218524fd5129641da769bb82462e4d`. The four modules in
`source/packages/railway-visuals` are unchanged copies of the Nautilus original
procedural railway track kit at `ed951ba4723ce4cdb87db25d226ad1ceaead7f46`
(branch `codex/railway-route-tool`, not yet on Nautilus main; its retained
record is `maps/mount-dora/art/source/nautilus/packages/railway-visuals/SOURCE.json`).
Exact hashes are in `provenance.json`. This map adapter does not register an
engine asset or change the game's engine pin. The original retained source
record is under `maps/mount-dora/art/source/nautilus/NOTICE.md` in the
repository.

Building outlines and landmark locations derive from the retained map data
© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0; see
https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright and `maps/mount-dora/source/NOTICE.txt`.
City and property-owner references inform approximate palettes and typologies.
No source photographs or Google imagery are included as textures.
